Task status is canonical in [plan/tasks.json](plan/tasks.json); [STATUS.md](STATUS.md) records the current narrative and evidence. Planning completion is separate from implementation, automated results, runtime proof, human review and public release.

This programme contains **228 current task rows in 28 waves**, including **50 narrow 0.1 outcomes**. The exact 27 historical source objects (three DONE documentation/tooling foundations and 24 PLANNED scientific/build contracts) remain unchanged in [immutable lineage](plan/lineage/manifest.json). New outcomes do not retroactively complete the original contracts.

Every row below is a bounded outcome contract. `evidenceRefs` must identify actual evidence before a new task advances beyond PLANNED. Human and public-release evidence remain distinct; DONE is reserved for the three retained historical foundation rows.
